target_customer: Shopify e-commerce merchants and DTC brands that sell to shoppers by SMS, later email and RCS
problem: Shopify merchants had no native way to run compliant SMS marketing and conversations with shoppers, while email was crowded and low in engagement.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription tied to list size and message volume, with carrier message fees passed through
product_category: SMS and retention marketing platform for e-commerce

founders.name: Adam Turner
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder and CEO on the YC page. Background not found in opened sources.

founders.name: Colin Turner
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder, described as a full-stack business nerd. Background not found.

founders.name: Alex Beller
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him co-founder overseeing revenue and people. Background not found.

competitors.name: SMSBump
competitors.what: SMS marketing app for Shopify merchants

competitors.name: Klaviyo
competitors.what: Email marketing platform for e-commerce that was adding SMS

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on Twilio SMS APIs with Shopify integration; hard parts were carrier compliance, deliverability and scaling message throughput.

defensibility.rationale: Thin software layer over Twilio at founding and rivals launched in the same period; later gains came from subscriber lists, Shopify app distribution and carrier relationships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Klaviyo added SMS later, and Yotpo exited email and SMS in 2025 per a trade report; Postscript stayed independent and made its first acquisition (Fondue) in 2023.

market_need_then: In 2018 and 2019 merchants saw email engagement falling and wanted a higher open rate channel; the TechCrunch seed coverage frames SMS as an underserved channel for Shopify shops.

branding.name_origin: A Twilio Ventures profile says the founders chose Postscript for its friendly, casual feel and a nod to scripting and marketing automation.

identity.voice_and_tone: Current tagline is 'Retention, Rebuilt', positioned around AI

branding.community_and_virality: A 2020 'vault' content hub and merchant case studies exist; no evidence of merch or fan communities.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly word but generic and not distinctive in search; growth is attributed in sources to Shopify focus and product, not the brand.

outcome_analysis: Postscript focused exclusively on Shopify and rode the shift of e-commerce brands toward SMS. It raised a $4.5M seed in December 2019, a $35M Series B in March 2021 (skipping a Series A) and a $65M Series C in June 2022, and says it now drives over $2B a year in merchant revenue. A listing aggregator reports a 19 percent layoff after the Series C, undated and unverified. It remains active at about 180 people.
notes: Founder backgrounds not found. Competitor sources are the seed article, so traction and funding at the time are unknown. One article says 2024 for the Fondue deal while others say 2023. Layoff report is undated. Third party valuation of 636M is unverified and not recorded.
